nl: Enable the setting `slow_query_log = 1` in my.cnf by removing the comment marker from its line. Other commented lines stay commented.
oracle_program: lines "my.cnf" |> filter text == "#slow_query_log = 1" |> replace "#slow_query_log = 1" "slow_query_log = 1" mode: literal
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('my.cnf')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = '#slow_query_log = 1\n'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, 'slow_query_log = 1\n').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
